<subject>Re: Results of the Bankruptcy Hearing for TCO's Issues With [ORG_4]</subject>
<body>
You should have the email below in your inbox regarding the credit facilities with Halcyon. Please confirm to the team below whether [ORG_5] can access the facility without maintaining a minimum balance.

</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Owen, Julia  
Sent: Tuesday, 29 April 2025 4:09 PM
To: Hamilton, Derek; Hutchinson, Ross; Johnston, Laura; Marian Hussain, Debra
Cc: Sophie Jr., Ed; Mann, Gregory; m796@maroragroup.com'; s692@soldynlabs.com'; Barker, Mathew; Amy, Joshua; Garza, Kathleen; m789@trinorco.com'; j244@trinorco.com'; Holmes, Sean A.
Subject: Results of the Bankruptcy Hearing for TCO's Issues With [ORG_4]

Here is a quick update on how [ORG_4], TCO, bankruptcy hearing went last week for the [ORG_4] issues:

TCO agreed to withdraw the portion of their motion that was associated with [ORG_4]. The bank confirmed that [ORG_4] has been using their lending agreements and have been meeting all payment obligations since the bankruptcy petition date.  
The £1.8 million claim that TCO had included in the [COMPANY] "set off amount" (i.e. the remaining facility charges for [ORG_4]'s agreements until maturity) was removed from TCO's Motion.  
The minimum reserve requirement under the pooling arrangement should no longer be enforced by the lender (Note: Originally TCO appeared to be using [ORG_4]'s reserve to offset [ORG_3] & [ORG_4] liabilities).  

I would recommend that you challenge TCO's operations team if they continue to assert that [ORG_4] must maintain a minimum balance in your facility. If you have any issues, please let me know and I will re-engage our external counsel.

Thanks,  
Julia Owen
</quoted>
